brief: What is the capacity of Coral Bay Olefins' Sungai Liang cracker?

sections.title: Capacity of Coral Bay Olefins' Sungai Liang Cracker
questions: What is the nameplate or reported capacity of the Sungai Liang cracker operated by Coral Bay Olefins?
Is there any public confirmation or estimate of this capacity in the available sources?
sections.tool_rationale: 'describe_corpus' and 'query_plant_register' establish whether the capacity is published or withheld; 'search_part_a_documents' checks for any mention or disclosure in company or industry documents.
sections.unanswerable_if: No public source in the corpus (register or documents) discloses or estimates the capacity of the Sungai Liang cracker.

excluded.topic: Capacity forecast or future expansions for Sungai Liang cracker
excluded.reason: The brief only asks for current capacity, and there is no evidence in the corpus of future plans or forecasts for this unit.
